themes_detail.label: Street Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from streets and sidewalks spiked to 98 THIS WEEK, a 351% increase over the 8-week baseline average of 21.8 weekly complaints (z-score: 6.97), suggesting a sudden, concentrated noise problem affecting outdoor public spaces in Fort Greene/Brooklyn Heights.
evidence: 98 street/sidewalk noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 21.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Represents 4.5x normal complaint volume in a single week
reporting_angles: Interview residents on affected blocks to identify source: construction, street vendors, bars, or events
Cross-reference with DOB permits (1,183 total filed in last 90 days, 853 alterations) to see if construction activity correlates with spike

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints jumped to 5 THIS WEEK, a 400% increase from the 8-week baseline of 1.0 weekly complaint (z-score: 8.0), suggesting potential sanitation, pest, or disease concerns requiring immediate Department of Sanitation investigation.
evidence: 5 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Simultaneous spike in 'Animal in a Park' complaints (10 complaints last week vs 2.1 avg, +371%) suggests broader wildlife/rodent issue
reporting_angles: Request DSNY records on collection locations and any known pest infestations or disease concerns
Interview community board or Parks Department on whether park wildlife patterns are abnormal

themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Complaints
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints (Uber, Lyft, etc.) rose to 33 THIS WEEK, a 149% increase over the 8-week baseline of 13.2 weekly complaints (z-score: 6.7), pointing to increased traffic congestion, illegal parking, or unsafe driving behavior concentrated in the last 7 days.
evidence: 33 for-hire vehicle complaints THIS WEEK vs. 13.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Occurs alongside illegal parking complaints (6,538 total over 90 days, highest category), suggesting gig vehicle drivers may be exacerbating existing parking crisis
reporting_angles: Survey residents on Flatbush Avenue Extension and high-traffic corridors about for-hire vehicle congestion and safety
Investigate whether TLC enforcement is active or if driver behavior has changed (surge pricing events, driver shortages)

themes_detail.label: Construction Hazard Spike
themes_detail.summary: Construction Lead Dust complaints jumped to 4 THIS WEEK, a 540% increase from the 8-week baseline of 0.6 weekly complaints (z-score: 4.85), raising health concerns in a district with 1,183 DOB building permits filed in the past 90 days and ongoing ULURP development proposals.
evidence: 4 construction lead dust complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Concurrent spike in 'Building/Use' complaints (7 last week vs 1.1 avg, +522%), suggesting multiple construction-related issues active simultaneously
reporting_angles: Identify which of the 1,183 active DOB permits are for renovation/alteration work on older buildings (high lead risk)
Interview parents and schools about children's exposure; contact NYC Health Dept on lead dust protocols

themes_detail.label: Real-Time Enforcement Anomaly
themes_detail.summary: Real-time enforcement complaints spiked to 8 LAST WEEK, a 1500% increase from the 8-week baseline of 0.5 weekly complaints (z-score: 10.61), suggesting either a new police initiative or public concern about enforcement methods that warrant investigation.
evidence: 8 real-time enforcement complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Complaints are vague; unclear if related to traffic enforcement, street vendor enforcement (342 complaints over 90 days), or other city agency action
reporting_angles: FOIL request to NYPD 84th Precinct for any new enforcement initiatives or surge operations in the past 2 weeks
Contact 311 data team to understand complaint details and whether complaints name specific enforcement activity
